_comment: B-04 shared route table. Every gateway runs it: devgateway (services/identity/cmd/devgateway, route_table_test.go) and depot-server (tools/depot-server, route_table_test.go) end to end against a real OPA loaded from policies/authz, and Envoy statically (deploy/scripts/test_gateway.py, AuthzEnforcement) plus through data.authz.envoy, the rule the Envoy ext_authz OPA answers (gateway_test.rego). Each case is one subject of the tenant with the tenant-wide duties in duties, the legal-entity-scoped duties in scoped_duties (legal entity -> duties) and the token's le claim in legal_entity. path is the public path; allow is what every gateway must answer. Every path is a browser path (/api/v1/...): the single-host gateways serve no other, while Envoy also serves the partner paths (/v1/...) and decides them on the same resource. Paths under the D22 prefixes (agents, copilot, cutover, edi, mcp, migration, print) are not here either: Envoy rewrites them to the service's own base and the single-host gateways do not. gateway_test.rego covers both in Envoy.
